method.browser: Separate headless Chromium, JavaScript disabled, all network routes aborted, 1365x1000
method.structure: Reparse saved source live DOM; compare all capture-proof ancestor chains before sanitization. Compare body, every control and relative order, complete ancestors/sibling indexes, all table cells, heading/form roles, frame metadata and ARIA reference nodes after declared script-removal/editable-input sanitization.
method.visibility: Use source-proof CSS visibility predicate, which includes offscreen rendered controls and excludes hidden/zero-sized controls. Viewport intersection is not asserted.
method.semantics: Independent manual review of every visible accepted/rejected annotation under supplied six-category and action contract. No product/classifier/test executed.
method.accessibilityNames: Also captured independent Playwright ariaSnapshot for every one of the 291 original CSS-visible controls in inert replay, with zero snapshot failures. This checks browser accessibility names separately from the supplied fixed-metadata name collector; it is not a live VoiceOver test.
